q: How much did we pay on hail claims in Colorado in Q2 2025?
gold_sql: select sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and c.peril = 'hail' and c.state = 'CO' and p.paid_date between '2025-04-01' and '2025-06-30' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: How many claims were reported in the North in January 2025?
gold_sql: select count(*) as value from core.claims c where c.region = 'North' and c.loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-01-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: What was average severity by peril last year?
gold_sql: with pt as (select claim_id, sum(amount) paid from core.payments p where p.status <> 'voided' group by claim_id) select c.peril as grp, sum(pt.paid) / count(*) as value from core.claims c join pt using (claim_id) where c.status = 'closed' and pt.paid > 0 and c.closed_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s) group by c.peril

q: Denial rate for wind claims in 2025 versus 2024
gold_sql: select (count(*) filter (where status = 'denied' and closed_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31'))::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where closed_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31'), 0) as value_current, (count(*) filter (where status = 'denied' and closed_date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31'))::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where closed_date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31'), 0) as value_prior from core.claims where peril = 'wind' and status in ('closed', 'denied') and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: Paid losses by month in 2026
gold_sql: select to_char(date_trunc('month', p.paid_date), 'YYYY-MM') as grp, sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and p.paid_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30' and c.region = any(%(regions)s) group by 1

q: What's the loss ratio in the West for Q3 2025?
gold_sql: select (select sum(p.amount) from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and c.region = 'West' and p.paid_date between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-30') / (select sum(amount) from core.earned_premium where region = 'West' and month between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-01') as value where 'West' = any(%(regions)s)

q: How many wind claims did Texas have in 2025?
gold_sql: select count(*) as value from core.claims where peril = 'wind' and state = 'TX' and loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: Claim count by region in 2025
gold_sql: select region as grp, count(*) as value from core.claims where loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and region = any(%(regions)s) group by region

q: What are our open reserves?
gold_sql: select sum(reserve) as value from core.claims where status = 'open' and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: Average severity for hail claims in Colorado in Q3 2025
gold_sql: with pt as (select claim_id, sum(amount) paid from core.payments p where p.status <> 'voided' group by claim_id) select sum(pt.paid) / count(*) as value from core.claims c join pt using (claim_id) where c.status = 'closed' and pt.paid > 0 and c.peril = 'hail' and c.state = 'CO' and c.closed_date between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-30' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: How many water claims were there in Minnesota last year?
gold_sql: select count(*) as value from core.claims where peril = 'water' and state = 'MN' and loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and region = any(%(regions)s)

q: Denial rate by region this year
gold_sql: select region as grp, (count(*) filter (where status = 'denied'))::numeric / count(*) as value from core.claims where status in ('closed', 'denied') and closed_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30' and region = any(%(regions)s) group by region

q: Paid losses by quarter in 2025
gold_sql: select to_char(date_trunc('quarter', p.paid_date), 'YYYY-"Q"Q') as grp, sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and p.paid_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s) group by 1

q: How many claims had a payment in May 2026?
gold_sql: select count(distinct p.claim_id) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and p.paid_date between '2026-05-01' and '2026-05-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: Paid losses by peril in Pennsylvania in 2025
gold_sql: select c.peril as grp, sum(p.amount) as value from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and c.state = 'PA' and p.paid_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and c.region = any(%(regions)s) group by c.peril

q: Loss ratio by region for 2025
gold_sql: with paid as (select c.region, sum(p.amount) v from core.payments p join core.claims c using (claim_id) where p.status <> 'voided' and p.paid_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by c.region), prem as (select region, sum(amount) v from core.earned_premium where month between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-01' group by region) select paid.region as grp, paid.v / prem.v as value from paid join prem using (region) where paid.region = any(%(regions)s)

q: Water claims in the North by month in 2025
gold_sql: select to_char(date_trunc('month', loss_date), 'YYYY-MM') as grp, count(*) as value from core.claims where region = 'North' and peril = 'water' and loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and region = any(%(regions)s) group by 1

q: Hail claims in Colorado by month in 2025

q: Paid losses in 2025 compared to 2024
